text: The Nasdaq fell 1.48% to 23,733.54 and the S&P 500 slipped 0.50% to 7,201.09, while the Dow rose 0.85% to close above 50,000.
Tech was the weakest sector, down 2.77%, on worries about AI spending, stretched valuations and possible new US tariffs.
Every metal settled lower: December gold futures fell 2.45% to $3,561.90 and silver fell 5.54% to $40.78, silver's biggest drop in the group.
SLV fell 5.32% to $36.84, giving back Monday's gain.
Gold miners fell less than gold: GDX lost 1.96% to $71.37, while the junior miners in GDXJ dropped 3.15% to $84.17.
TQQQ fell 5.93% to $46.19 as QQQ dropped about 2%, giving back part of Monday's surge.
Brent rose 2.3% to settle at $91.40 after renewed tanker attacks, bouncing from Monday's three-month low.
The $70 billion 5-year Treasury auction sold at 4.719% with normal demand, and the 10-year yield ended near 4.90%, little changed.
